name: Arkeshwar Rasa

sections.introduction: Arkeshwar rasa is an Ayurvedic formulation. The ingredients in this medicine are effective in various blood disorders.
sections.ingredients:
Abhrak Bhasma 
 Loha Bhasma 
 Vanga Bhasma 
 Swarna-makshik Bhasma
sections.description_of_main_ingredients:
Abhrak Bhasma – Abhrak bhasma is calcined mica ash. It is used in ayurveda for abdominal, respiratory problems. It has anti-inflammatory and digestive properties. 
 Loha Bhasma – It has hematogenic properties (helps in formation of RBCs). It pacifies pitta dosha. It maintains the normal level of blood in the body. 
 Vanga Bhasma – It is very good in patients with anemia, urinary tract infections, diabetes, asthma etc. It also helps in obesity by promoting weight loss. 
 Swarna-makshik Bhasma – The purified powder of swarna makshik is very effective in jaundice, anemia, joint pain and weakness, insomnia, etc. It aids in treating chronic fever also. 

 Method of Preparation 

 Properly mix all the above ingredients in a kharal yantra. 
 Give Guduchi swaras bhavna ( Tinospora cordifolia ) and after cooked this mixture over gaj put (specially designed instrument). 
 Remove this mixture from gajput and give proper frolement. 
 Kept this mixture in airtight glass container. 

 Medicinal Properties 
 Arkeshwar rasa is a herbo-mineral composition. This formulation has hematogenic properties which is useful in the formation of RBCs. Swarna (Gold) is used for the nourishment of rasadi dhatus (bodily tissues). This Ayurvedic formulation is used for the treatment of Raktapitta (various blood disorders).
sections.indications: Raktapitta (various blood disorders like ITP, Glanzmann thrombasthenia, Epistaxis etc.).

2 tablets twice a day with the extracts of Vasa ( Adhatoda vasica ). 
 Cautions 

 Avoid in pregnancy. 
 Take under the medical supervision. 


 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.

fullContent:
Arkeshwar Rasa 
 Reference – Bhaishajya-Ratnavali Raktapittadhikar 393/46-47 
 Introduction 
 Arkeshwar rasa is an Ayurvedic formulation. The ingredients in this medicine are effective in various blood disorders. 
 Ingredients 
 
 Abhrak Bhasma 
 Loha Bhasma 
 Vanga Bhasma 
 Swarna-makshik Bhasma 
 
 Description of Main Ingredients 
 
 Abhrak Bhasma – Abhrak bhasma is calcined mica ash. It is used in ayurveda for abdominal, respiratory problems. It has anti-inflammatory and digestive properties. 
 Loha Bhasma – It has hematogenic properties (helps in formation of RBCs). It pacifies pitta dosha. It maintains the normal level of blood in the body. 
 Vanga Bhasma – It is very good in patients with anemia, urinary tract infections, diabetes, asthma etc. It also helps in obesity by promoting weight loss. 
 Swarna-makshik Bhasma – The purified powder of swarna makshik is very effective in jaundice, anemia, joint pain and weakness, insomnia, etc. It aids in treating chronic fever also. 
 
 Method of Preparation 
 
 Properly mix all the above ingredients in a kharal yantra. 
 Give Guduchi swaras bhavna ( Tinospora cordifolia ) and after cooked this mixture over gaj put (specially designed instrument). 
 Remove this mixture from gajput and give proper frolement. 
 Kept this mixture in airtight glass container. 
 
 Medicinal Properties 
 Arkeshwar rasa is a herbo-mineral composition. This formulation has hematogenic properties which is useful in the formation of RBCs. Swarna (Gold) is used for the nourishment of rasadi dhatus (bodily tissues). This Ayurvedic formulation is used for the treatment of Raktapitta (various blood disorders). 
 Indications 
 Raktapitta (various blood disorders like ITP, Glanzmann thrombasthenia, Epistaxis etc.). 
 Dosage 
 2 tablets twice a day with the extracts of Vasa ( Adhatoda vasica ). 
 Cautions 
 
 Avoid in pregnancy. 
 Take under the medical supervision. 
 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
